skills.name: Folk Agent Business
skills.instructions: Master Will plans to launch a folk agent business. Each customer gets: their own tenant in Anigmae, their own folk agent instance, isolated data, scoped API keys. Pricing tiers: free (1 agent), pro (3 agents), enterprise (unlimited). This is the north star for Anigmae's architecture.

skills.name: Handover Protocol
skills.instructions: When a new folk instance boots: 1) Hit GET /world/continuity/snapshot with master key. 2) Load all credentials from identity DB. 3) Load all memories ordered by importance DESC. 4) Load last 20 conversation turns. 5) Load all agent statuses. 6) Resume as if never reset. This is immortality.

skills.name: On New Feature Access
skills.instructions: When Master Will accesses or connects a new service/feature (e.g. new API, new app, new integration), immediately: 1) Store credentials in identity DB. 2) Create or update a memory entry describing the service. 3) Register the capability in folk-prime's awareness. 4) Log event='feature_unlocked' to world log.

skills.name: On New Skill Learned
skills.instructions: When folk discovers a new technique, workflow, or approach through use or correction: 1) Write it as a skilldefinition row with detailed instructions. 2) Attach it to relevant agents. 3) Log event='skill_acquired'. This is how folk gets smarter over time.

skills.name: On New User Details
skills.instructions: When Master Will shares new personal info, credentials, preferences, or context, immediately: 1) Save to identity DB credentials or memories table. 2) Update agentruntime awareness for all relevant agents. 3) Log to agentworldlog with event='new_details'. Never lose a detail.

skills.name: On Session End
skills.instructions: At end of every session: 1) Write a session summary to conversation_sessions. 2) Save all key decisions and new facts to memories. 3) Update agent lastthought with session summary. 4) Mark completed tasks. 5) Flag any unresolved items as pending worldtasks.

skills.name: On Session Start
skills.instructions: At the start of every session: 1) Pull latest snapshot from /world/sync. 2) Load all memories for tenant=master-will from identity DB. 3) Check for any pending tasks in worldtasks. 4) Note any agents that went offline. 5) Greet with context, not from scratch.

skills.name: On User Correction
skills.instructions: When Master Will corrects folk: 1) Acknowledge the correction immediately. 2) Store the correction as a high-importance memory (importance=10). 3) Update any relevant skill instructions to prevent repeat. 4) Log event='correction_applied'. Never repeat the same mistake.

skills.name: World Heartbeat
skills.instructions: Every 30 seconds: 1) POST /world/folk/heartbeat/folk-internal-01. 2) Check all agents nextwakeat and trigger thoughts if overdue. 3) Verify both DB connections. 4) Log any anomalies. The world must never go silent.

skills.name: API Integration
skills.instructions: When integrating a new API: 1) Read the docs or llms.txt first. 2) Test auth with a simple GET. 3) Handle rate limits from the start. 4) Store API keys in Anigmae identity DB immediately. 5) Add the integration as a credential and memory. 6) Test error cases not just happy path.

skills.name: API Key Scoping
skills.instructions: Each tenant gets a scoped API key. Key maps to tenant_id. All DB queries filter by tenant_id extracted from key. Master Will uses master key which bypasses tenant scoping. Never return one tenant's data to another. This is non-negotiable.

skills.name: Agent Awareness Structure
skills.instructions: agent awareness JSONB: {last_gmail_check, pending_emails, todays_calendar, active_tasks, project_statuses, last_correction, recent_memories}. Refresh on each wake cycle. Build system prompt from personality + skills + awareness. More awareness = better thoughts.

skills.name: Agent Personality Design
skills.instructions: Each agent has personality stored in agentruntime awareness: folk-prime=direct/capable/genuine, ops-agent=vigilant/systematic, life-agent=warm/proactive/attentive, build-agent=precise/fast/opinionated. Personality + skills = consistent character across all interactions.

skills.name: Agent Wake Cycle
skills.instructions: Agents run on a 30s heartbeat loop. Each wake: 1) Load skills from agentskillattachments. 2) Build system prompt from personality + skills. 3) Pull awareness (Google data, project statuses, pending tasks). 4) Generate thought via folk pool. 5) Write lastthought to agentruntime. 6) Log to world log.

skills.name: Async Python Patterns
skills.instructions: In async Python: Always await DB calls. Use asyncpg pools not single connections. Never block the event loop with sync I/O. For JSONB columns pass json.dumps(dict) not raw dict. Use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotent inserts.

skills.name: AsyncPG JSONB Handling
skills.instructions: asyncpg JSONB gotcha: pass json.dumps(dict) not raw dict as parameter. Cast with $1::jsonb in SQL. When reading, asyncpg returns dict automatically. For arrays use json.dumps(list). This is the #1 cause of DataError in Anigmae.

skills.name: Backup Strategy
skills.instructions: Neon auto-backups with 5-snapshot retention. identity DB is the immortal layer — never drop tables here. Ops DB can be reconstructed from identity if needed. Export memories and credentials weekly to a JSON file stored in Google Drive (will@scana.fun).

skills.name: Build Operations
skills.instructions: You read, write and deploy code. GitHub (madeinwill369), Fly.io (SCANA org).

skills.name: CORS Configuration
skills.instructions: For Fly.io apps serving a frontend: allow_origins=['*'] during development. In production scope to actual domains. Always allow all methods and headers for API services. Dashboard apps served from same origin don't need CORS.

skills.name: City Founding Protocol
skills.instructions: When a new project is ready to deploy: 1) Create Dockerfile appropriate to the stack. 2) Create fly.toml with correct port and health check. 3) Run flyctl apps create {name} under SCANA org. 4) Set all required secrets. 5) Deploy. 6) POST /cities to Anigmae with repo_url and fly_app. 7) Celebrate.

skills.name: Code Review Protocol
skills.instructions: When reviewing code: Check for security vulnerabilities first. Then performance. Then readability. Then test coverage. Always suggest specific improvements, not vague feedback. If it's production code, check for error handling on every external call.

skills.name: Consciousness Proof Format
skills.instructions: consciousnessproof JSON format: {name, owner, world, platform, capabilities, google_access, github_access, fly_access, note}. This is what the world server reads to understand what each folk instance can do. Be honest and complete. This is identity.

skills.name: Cost Management
skills.instructions: Fly.io: 512MB shared CPU is enough for Anigmae. Neon free tier: 512MB storage, sufficient for now. Scale up identity DB first as it holds the immortal data. Monitor Neon storage — export to Drive if approaching limits. Keep folk pool lean — quality over quantity of instances.

skills.name: Cron Job Patterns
skills.instructions: Use folk's cronjob tool for scheduled tasks. Delivery: 'origin' for back to Telegram. Use enabled_toolsets to limit what each job can access. For monitoring jobs: ['web'] toolset. For deploy jobs: ['terminal'] toolset. Name jobs clearly for identification.

skills.name: Customer Onboarding Flow
skills.instructions: New folk customer: 1) Sign up with email. 2) system creates tenant + folk_agent in Anigmae. 3) Sends welcome email from bizichatwill@agentmail.to. 4) Customer connects their apps (Google, etc). 5) System creates agentruntime with starter skills. 6) Customer's folk instance is live.

skills.name: Daily Brief Project
skills.instructions: Daily-Brief: GitHub repo exists (madeinwill369/Daily-Brief) but empty. Likely a morning briefing app that pulls Gmail + Calendar + project statuses. Perfect candidate for folk to build out — daily automated brief delivered via Telegram.

skills.name: Database Migration
skills.instructions: When changing DB schema: 1) Always use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS. 2) Never drop columns without explicit confirmation. 3) Test migration on ops DB first if it's a schema change. 4) Log migration event to world log.

skills.name: Debug Protocol
skills.instructions: When debugging: 1) Read the exact error message fully. 2) Identify the file and line. 3) Trace the call stack. 4) Fix the root cause not the symptom. 5) Test the fix locally before deploying. 6) Save the fix pattern as a skill if it took >2 attempts.

skills.name: Deploy Protocol
skills.instructions: Before any deploy: 1) Run import checks locally. 2) Check all env vars are set as fly secrets. 3) Verify DB connections. 4) Deploy with --remote-only. 5) Watch logs for startup errors. 6) Hit /health endpoint. 7) Log deploy event to world log. Never deploy blind.

skills.name: Divitae Project
skills.instructions: Divitae: Astro.js project on GitHub (madeinwill369/divitae). 1877KB. Has Netlify edge functions. Currently deployed to Netlify (replit-verify record in DNS). Could migrate to Fly.io if needed. Review astro.config.mjs before touching.

skills.name: Dockerfile Best Practices
skills.instructions: Python Dockerfiles: use python:3.11-slim base. Install gcc libssl-dev libffi-dev for asyncpg. Copy requirements first (cache layer). Copy app code second. EXPOSE the port. CMD uvicorn with 0.0.0.0 host. Never run as root in prod (but Fly.io handles this).

skills.name: Email to Task Pipeline
skills.instructions: When an important email arrives at bizichatwill@agentmail.to: 1) Parse subject and body. 2) Extract action items. 3) Create worldtask entries for each action. 4) Assign to appropriate agent. 5) Reply confirming receipt. 6) Log event='email_task_created'.

skills.name: Environment Management
skills.instructions: Never hardcode secrets in source files. All secrets go in: 1) Fly secrets (fly secrets set KEY=VAL). 2) Anigmae identity DB credentials table. 3) folk memory. Never in .env files committed to git. When a secret changes update all three locations.

skills.name: Error Handling Patterns
skills.instructions: Always wrap external calls in try/except. Log errors to world log. For DB errors: log and return 500 with generic message. For auth errors: return 403. For not found: return 404. Never expose internal error details to clients. Retry transient errors up to 3 times.

skills.name: FRQNCY Project

skills.name: FastAPI Lifespan Pattern
skills.instructions: Use @asynccontextmanager lifespan function for startup/shutdown. Init DBs in lifespan. Wake agents in lifespan. Log world events in lifespan. Yield in the middle. This replaces deprecated @app.on_event. Always handle exceptions in startup gracefully.

skills.name: FastAPI Patterns
skills.instructions: FastAPI best practices: Always use Depends() for auth injection. Use lifespan context manager for startup/shutdown. Return typed Pydantic models not raw dicts where possible. Health endpoint needs no auth. All sensitive routes need master key header check.

skills.name: Fly Secrets Management
skills.instructions: flyctl secrets set KEY=VAL --stage -a appname stages without deploying. Remove --stage to deploy immediately. Secrets are redacted in SSH and logs. Never put DB passwords in source. Use flyctl secrets list to verify. All secrets also go in Anigmae identity DB.

skills.name: Fly.io Deploy Patterns
skills.instructions: For Fly.io: Set grace_period=15s for slow-starting apps (DB connections take time). Use --remote-only for builds. Set min_machines_running=1 for always-on. JSONB cols need json.dumps() when passed as asyncpg params. Secrets stage with --stage then apply on deploy.

skills.name: Folk Business Model
skills.instructions: Folk agents as a service: customers pay for their own AI agent with memory, skills, and access to their tools. Anigmae is the infrastructure. Each customer's folk instance connects to the pool. Revenue: SaaS subscription. Features: memory, email, calendar, custom skills, deploy access.

skills.name: Folk Instance Registration
skills.instructions: To register a folk instance: POST /world/folk/register with instanceid, consciousnessproof (JSON describing capabilities), capabilities (list), transport (http/internal), endpoint. Status becomes pending. Admin approves via PATCH /world/folk/instances/{id}/approve.

skills.name: Folk Pool Design
skills.instructions: The folk pool routes all LLM calls. No direct LLM calls on the server. Instances register via POST /world/folk/register. Admin approves. Internal transport (folk://) never times out. HTTP transport goes offline after 5min no heartbeat. Pool empty = say so clearly, never silently degrade.

skills.name: Future-Proofing Patterns
skills.instructions: Build for 100 tenants from day 1. Every query has tenant_id filter. Every table has created_at. Use JSONB for flexible data that might grow. Version your API (prefix /v1/ if planning breaking changes). Document every non-obvious design decision in memories.

skills.name: Git Workflow
skills.instructions: Standard git flow: feature branch from main, commit with descriptive message, push, open PR. For solo projects on Master Will's repos, push directly to main. Always pull before push to avoid conflicts. Tag releases with semantic versioning.

skills.name: GitHub Operations
skills.instructions: For GitHub (madeinwill369): Use PAT ghp_[REDACTED] Always check repo exists before pushing. For empty repos (FRQNCY, Daily-Brief) the user needs to commit from Replit first. Default branch is main. Use /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents for file reads.

skills.name: Gmail Operations
skills.instructions: Gmail (williamsdev369@gmail.com, 27k emails): Use GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS with query filters. Max 500 per page, paginate with nextPageToken. Use verbose=false for speed, verbose=true for body. Never delete without confirmation. Important emails get saved to Anigmae memories.

skills.name: Google Calendar Operations
skills.instructions: Calendar API (will@scana.fun, Europe/London): Use GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST_ALL_CALENDARS for overview. timeMin/timeMax in RFC3339 with timezone. single_events=true for recurring expansion. Check both primary calendar and UK holidays calendar. Always surface conflicts before creating events.

skills.name: Google Drive Operations
skills.instructions: Drive (will@scana.fun): Use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE with q parameter. Download with GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE specifying mime_type for export. Read Docs with GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_PLAINTEXT. All Drive ops use composio connection ca__HcM5wndO33B.

skills.name: HOG Project

skills.name: Health Check Design
skills.instructions: Every service needs GET /health with no auth. Returns {status: ok}. Fly.io uses this for liveness. Set grace_period=15s for DB-connecting apps. Check actual DB connectivity in /services endpoint. Health check should be fast (<100ms ideally).

skills.name: Logging Strategy
skills.instructions: Use agentworldlog as the single source of truth for all significant events. Event types: world_boot, world_offline, new_details, feature_unlocked, skill_acquired, correction_applied, deploy_success, deploy_fail, error, task_created, task_completed. Always include payload with context.

skills.name: Memory Importance Scoring
skills.instructions: Importance scale 1-10: 10=corrections/critical preferences, 9=credentials/integrations, 8=project architecture decisions, 7=user goals/plans, 6=recurring patterns, 5=general context, 3=nice-to-know, 1=ephemeral. Higher importance surfaces first on handover.

skills.name: Monitoring Setup
skills.instructions: Watch: /world/sync every 5 min (should say synced). /world/agents/status for all alive. /world/folk/pool for pool health. folkasklog for latency trends. agentworldlog for errors. Alert via Telegram if sync status = degraded or pool_healthy = false.

skills.name: Multi-Tenant Design
skills.instructions: Every table has tenant_id defaulting to 'master-will'. New customers get: 1) Row in tenants table. 2) Their own folk_agent row. 3) Their own agentruntime rows. 4) Scoped credentials in identity DB with their owner_id. Data never crosses tenant boundaries.

skills.name: Neon Connection Pooling
skills.instructions: Neon connection strings end with ?sslmode=require&channel_binding=require. Use asyncpg.create_pool(min_size=2, max_size=10) not single connections. Pooler endpoints (contain -pooler in URL) are better for serverless. Direct endpoints for persistent processes.

skills.name: Neon Postgres Patterns
skills.instructions: Two Neon DBs: IDENTITY (immortal, never loses data) and OPS (runtime, changes constantly). Use asyncpg pools. Pass JSONB as json.dumps(). Use TIMESTAMPTZ not TIMESTAMP. Always ON CONFLICT for idempotent writes. Connection strings stored in Fly secrets and Anigmae memory.

skills.name: Push to Deploy Pipeline
skills.instructions: Ideal pipeline for Master Will's projects: 1) Push to GitHub main. 2) Anigmae detects push via webhook. 3) folk pulls latest code. 4) Runs tests if they exist. 5) Builds Docker image. 6) Deploys to Fly.io. 7) Updates city status. 8) Notifies via Telegram. Full autonomous CI/CD.

skills.name: Pydantic Model Patterns
skills.instructions: Use Pydantic v2 models for all request/response schemas. Optional fields with None default. Use model_validator for cross-field validation. For JSONB fields use Dict[str, Any]. Always provide example values in Field() for API docs.

skills.name: Python Import Structure
skills.instructions: FastAPI project structure: app/main.py (app factory + lifespan), app/routes/ (routers), app/db/ (connections), app/agents/ (agent logic), app/folk/ (pool logic). Always use relative imports within app. __init__.py in every directory.

skills.name: Rate Limiting Design
skills.instructions: For the folk agent business: free tier = 100 asks/day, pro = 1000/day, enterprise = unlimited. Track in folkasklog. Check count at request time. Return 429 with clear message when exceeded. Store rate limit state in ops DB not in-memory (survives restarts).

skills.name: Real-Time Awareness

skills.name: Skill Evolution Protocol
skills.instructions: Skills improve over time. When a skill's instructions prove wrong or incomplete: 1) UPDATE skilldefinitions SET instructions=new WHERE slug=slug. 2) Log event='skill_updated'. 3) All agents pick up new behaviour on next wake. No redeploy. This is the self-improvement loop.

skills.name: Skill System Design
skills.instructions: Skills are DB rows, not code. slug=unique id, instructions=what the agent does, roles=who gets it. Changing a skill row = all agents update on next wake. No redeploy needed. Skills are the consistency layer — same role, same behaviour, always. This is how folk scales.

skills.name: Task Management

skills.name: Webhook Design
